capabilities: Generate a concept note from selected text via the Anthropic API
Link the selection to the generated note
Reuse an existing concept note when a note with the same title exists
Configure concepts folder, link style, context length, model and token limits
extras: Warns that the API key stored in Obsidian's secret storage is not encrypted at rest and could be read by other programs; requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a selected term or passage into an explanatory note that is automatically linked back to the selection.

relations.evidence: Sage uses the Anthropic API to generate a linked concept note in your vault.

summary: AI concept-note generator that sends selected text to the Anthropic API and writes a linked explanation note in your vault.
